title: Watch's stream-path hold alert still dereferences a nil command
description:
dfb is open and untouched by this tick: in the stream path's hold alert, the switch on hold reason dereferences *clearing with no nil check for several classes, while HoldClearingCommand returns nil whenever the epic id cannot be stated (its own tick-mwt rule), so a run_held line on a run whose epic is unstated panics the watch. One nil guard (fall back to the default case's wording) fixes it.
